original_title: Twelve people killed in Missouri plane crash, skydiving company says - Reuters

ai_analysis.detailed_analysis: A plane crash occurred in Missouri, resulting in the deaths of twelve people, according to a skydiving company. The incident is considered a high-risk event due to the severity of the crash and potential impact on aviation safety.
ai_analysis.immediate_forecast_24h: Investigations into the cause of the crash are likely to begin immediately, and aviation authorities may issue statements or take precautionary measures to ensure public safety.
